name: Billy Idol

whyMatters.en: Generation X frontman turned solo MTV act: Rebel Yell (1983) fused punk sneer with Steve Stevens guitar hooks and gated drums—post-punk attitude into 80s alternative/hard-radio crossover.
whyMatters.zh: Generation X 主唱转独唱 MTV 行动：Rebel Yell（1983）把朋克冷笑、Steve Stevens 吉他钩子与门限鼓钉在一起——后朋态度进 80 年代 alternative/硬电台跨界。

lyricQuotes: In the midnight hour she cried more, more, more
It's a nice day to start again

shortBio.en: Ex-Generation X solo; Rebel Yell and White Wedding as punk-to-MTV alternative hits.
shortBio.zh: 前 Generation X 独唱；Rebel Yell 与 White Wedding 作朋克到 MTV alternative 热单。

body.en:
William Broad fronted Generation X (1976–1981) in London punk. Solo career starts with Dancing with Myself (Generation X song reworked) and Billy Idol (1982). Steve Stevens becomes the guitar signature: Les Paul/Strat hooks, flamenco flourishes on Rebel Yell.

Rebel Yell (1983, Keith Forsey) is the citation LP—gated reverb drums, shout chorus, MTV video rotation. Eyes Without a Face is the ballad/dynamic drop. Treat the act as Billy Idol solo brand with Stevens as permanent co-architect.
body.zh:
William Broad 在伦敦朋克期主唱 Generation X（1976–1981）。独唱从 Dancing with Myself（Generation X 曲重做）与 Billy Idol（1982）起步。Steve Stevens 成吉他签名：Les Paul/Strat 钩子，Rebel Yell 上的弗拉门戈装饰。

Rebel Yell（1983，Keith Forsey）是引用 LP——门限混响鼓、喊叫副歌、MTV 轮播。Eyes Without a Face 是谣曲/动态回落。把行动当作 Billy Idol 独唱品牌，Stevens 为长期共构者。

title.zh: 朋克冷笑进 MTV 钩子

body.en:
Idol keeps Generation X attitude—short phrases, sneer vocal—then writes for gated-drum radio with Stevens.

Rebel Yell is the proof: punk energy, hard-rock guitar grammar, video-era chorus.

Not post-punk experiment; commercial alternative/punk crossover.
body.zh:
Idol 保留 Generation X 态度——短句、冷笑人声——再与 Stevens 为门限鼓电台写作。

Rebel Yell 是证明：朋克能量、hard-rock 吉他语法、影像期副歌。

非后朋实验；商业 alternative/朋克跨界。

body.en:
Solo brand centered on Idol voice and Stevens guitar from early 80s. Rhythm section rotates; writing credit often Idol/Stevens/Forsey.

Generation X is the punk résumé, not the ongoing band name.

Peak commercial unit is Rebel Yell touring band with Stevens.
body.zh:
独唱品牌从 80 年代初以 Idol 人声与 Stevens 吉他为中心。节奏组轮换；写作常记 Idol/Stevens/Forsey。

Generation X 是朋克履历，非持续乐队名。

商业巅峰单位是带 Stevens 的 Rebel Yell 巡演编制。

title.zh: 80 年代朋克到 alt 电台面孔

body.en:
Later punk/alternative acts cite Idol as proof punk sneer can sit on MTV without soft-rock wash.

The Killers and stadium alt borrow gated-era hook writing adjacent to this lane.

Debt is attitude + guitar hook, not DIY ethics alone.
body.zh:
后来朋克/alternative 行动引 Idol 为证明：朋克冷笑可上 MTV，不必软摇滚铺底。

The Killers 与体育场 alt 借用邻域门限期钩子写作。

债务在态度 + 吉他钩子，非仅 DIY 伦理。
